sentences.text:
Smt. Rekha Devi vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 21 March,
2023
Author: Ashutosh Srivastava

Bench: Ashutosh Srivastava
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 36
Case :- Writ - A No. - 3854 of 2023
Petitioner :- Smt. Rekha Devi
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 4 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Rajendra Prasad
Counsel for Respondent :- CSC,Shailendra Singh

Hon'ble Ashutosh Srivastava,J.
Heard Sri Rajendra Prasad, learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri Shailendra Singh, learned counsel for the Respondent Nos.2, 3 & 4 and Sri Shishir Tiwari, learned counsel for the Respondent No.1.
Considering the nature of the order proposed to be passed, the notice upon the Respondent No.5 is being dispensed with.

The present writ petition at the instance of the petitioner has been filed seeking issuance of a writ of mandamus commanding the Respondent Nos.2 & 3 to release the death claim as well as other benefits of deceased, Pooja Singh, in favour of her daughter namely Shristi.

A further prayer in the nature of mandamus directing the Respondent No.2, District Basic Education Officer, Lalitpur, to decide the representation dated 15.12.2022 of the petitioner within time framed fixed by this Court.
Smt. Rekha Devi vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198420644/

entities.text: Rekha Devi vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 It is contended that one Pooja Singh, who was working as Assistant Teacher, is stated to have married with one Jivendra son of Shiv Narayan, who has been arrayed as Respondent No.5.
The writ petition is at the instance of the mother of Pooja Singh.

It is alleged that the Respondent No.5 has done to death the daughter of the petitioner namely Pooja Singh and an FIR to this effect has also lodged under Sections 498A, 302, 201 and 404 IPC at Police Station Mahila Thana, District Lalitpur.
The daughter of Pooja Singh namely Shristi is residing with the petitioner.
Under these circumstances, the prayer for release of terminal dues of Pooja Singh in favour of the daughter of Pooja Singh namely Shristi has been sought.

Sri Shishir Tiwari, learned Standing Counsel as well as Sri Shailendra Singh submit that the petitioner has already approached the District Basic Education Officer, Lalitpur by way of representation and the writ petition may be disposed of by requiring the said respondent to pass appropriate orders on the pending representation.
Learned counsel for the petitioner is also aggreable to the aforesaid proposition.

This Court is also of the opinion that no useful purpose would be served by keeping the writ petition pending and it is, accordingly, disposed of with a direction that the Respondent No.2, District Basic Education Officer, Lalitpur, seized with the representation of the petitioner dated 15.12.2022 may pass appropriate orders thereon after considering all aspects of the matter, expeditiously preferably within a period of two months from the date of service of a certified copy of the order passed by this Court.
While deciding the claim of the petitioner, the Respondent No.2 may also hear the Respondent No.5, if he thinks proper.
It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the claim of the petitioner and it shall be open for the Respondent No.2 to pass appropriate orders in accordance with the law.
The writ petition is, accordingly, disposed of.
Order Date :- 21.3.2023 pks  Smt. Rekha Devi vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198420644/
